decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution has deep sunk investment, public reference customers like the UK Home Office, and over 30 government API connections, making it central to the firm's announced aviation security direction and very unlikely to be abandoned.

Although demand for travel health requirements may be waning after the pandemic, the API still has its own page, fits the firm's travel-data portfolio, and soft results can be attributed to temporary market conditions, so management is inclined to persist.

The travel and document verification platform is still featured on its own page, aligns with the firm's core document-security positioning, and represents committed development investment that management will want to justify by keeping it.
